title: Add the task-sync .gitattributes and .gitignore policy files to Engram's own engram-data branch
outcome: Add the task-sync .gitattributes and .gitignore policy files to Engram's own engram-data branch
acceptance: Engram's engram-data branch on origin carries .engram/.gitattributes and .engram/.gitignore with the shipped task-sync policy content (as fit_friends' data branch does), committed as a data-only fast-forward commit after the disclosure check
On Central, the next export and import in .engram-data show no LF-to-CRLF warnings and leave the worktree clean
